acceptedAnswer.text: A well-executed garage conversion can significantly enhance your home's functionality and appeal, contributing to its overall market value. While specific ROI varies by market and project scope, adding livable square footage is generally a strong investment, particularly in areas where space is at a premium. AKN Design Group focuses on customized solutions and quality craftsmanship to ensure your renovation is a lasting impression and a valuable asset, rather than a quick fix.
